remarks: VERY NICE…MOVE IN READY 2 STORY 3BD 1.5BTH! The residence is located on a quiet street offering a semi-private setting with no rear neighbors & natural shrubbery tree line back border, new fully fenced yard. Home offers an open-concept floor plan from eat-in kitchen that flows into a beautiful spacious living area featuring modern flooring overlooking a renovated fireplace as it’s focal point. The basement provides additional living & entertainment space, thoughtfully designed & ample storage with built-in wood shelving in laundry/mechanics room. Some updates include…new kitchen quartz countertops-sink/fixtures/lighting, upper full bath, majority of windows, floors/carpets, paint, fireplace mantle & tile! Enjoy the expansive sun–drenched backyard, endless possibilities to create your own private outdoor oasis. The spacious newly painted/surfaced two-tier deck/patio is complemented by a newer Pergola that extends to a finished stamped-concrete sitting area, providing an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining or relaxing. The patio is equipped with a 220-volt line, offering the potential for a sauna hot tub/pool. A well appointed storage shed provides convenient space for all your outdoor equipment & storage needs. Additionally, the enclosed storage area above the garage offers extra space & possible future expansion. Have "Peace of Mind" with dry basement, block windows, connected gutters, rewired electrical breaker panel, electric fireplace converted-wood burning, forced air, A/C, new garage springs, updated sump pump outlet, added outdoor front entrance GFI outlet, gas & electric-dryer hookup, new dishwasher outlet supply & all kitchen appliances included! Turn key home just make it your own in this nice sought after community. Close proximity to all amenities, minutes commute to thru-way/on ramps & City of Buffalo. Short walk to beautiful Stiglmeier Park Nature Preserve! Showings begin at Open House on Sat the 17th at 1:00.
